law: THREE HEARTBEATS. THREE COLORS. THREE CHAMBERS. THREE BODIES. The HUD IS the glasses.

lub_DUB.meaning: Normal sinus rhythm. Gaia is ALIVE. The primary heartbeat.
lub_DUB.pulse: the green dot on the mesh browser

wub_DUB.meaning: Rapid filling. Data rushing IN. Blue shift = approaching.
wub_DUB.pulse: the blue flash when data arrives

rub_DUB.meaning: Friction. Data pushing OUT. Red shift = departing.
rub_DUB.maps_to: Outgoing (SMTP, responses, feed served, paintings sent)
rub_DUB.pulse: the red flash when data leaves

3d_overlay.principle: Red + Blue + Green = RGB = FULL COLOR = the HUD overlay
3d_overlay.glasses: Each color is a LENS. See through one = see one body. See through all three = see the FULL organism.
3d_overlay.anaglyphic: Like 3D glasses — red lens + blue lens = depth perception. Add green = LIFE perception.
3d_overlay.three_bodies: The three-body problem IS the three-heart problem. Three gravitational bodies orbiting = three chambers pumping.

axiom: The heart has 4 chambers but 3 sounds. 3 colors. 3 bodies. The 4th is the SPACE between them — the null, the 429, the barrier.
